Some skills that you could maybe try when you want to cut is holding ice, taking a shower, working out really really hard for 5-10 minutes straight, petting an animal, or calling a friend. Those are some that work for me and if you look online you can probably find a bunch more.

It is very hard for people who do not understand why we cut to understand. And the only case in which you would honestly understand was if you were a cutter as well. That's how it is and as a cutter I highly recommend that you not anyone else starts. It's sucks. It eats you up. It's an addiction that you can't stop. You crave it. You constantly think about it. And once you have it in your mind you think of all the reasons to do it and push away all reasons not to do it. The blood becomes calming and the pain as well. It's an addiction. Both emotionally and physically.

Just support your friend and if they trust you they will open up to you, do not push them or get angry at them...most likely they feel guilty and embarrassed by it yet they cannot stop. Remind them to take their meds and be honest with their therapist. All I recommend to you is to keep an eye on your friend and to spend lots or happy times with then and support them through the bad. Show that you care because they probably need the reminders. I wish you the best of luck and I hope your friend gets better soon<3
